name: Knockout Bracket: Four Enter, One Stays
why_it_works: A bracket turns taste into a tournament, and people defend their favorite like it's their team. Giving the vote real stakes (the winner stays, gets a discount, or gets played live) makes every comment feel like it changes something, and the follow-up final pulls the same people back.

hook.pattern: Announce a head-to-head tournament with a real consequence for the loser.
examples: Four {{item_category}} enter. One stays. You decide.
Your vote decides what we keep. Choose wisely.
Round one. Two matchups. Zero ties allowed.

variables.name: stakes
variables.example: stays half price all next week

slides.headline: Four enter. One stays.
slides.body: The {{item_category}} bracket is open. The winner {{stakes}}.
slides.visual_prompt: Bold tournament bracket graphic in {{brand}} colors with four photo slots for {{item_category}}, sports-poster energy, 4:5

slides.headline: Matchup 1: {{option_1}} vs {{option_2}}
slides.visual_prompt: Split vertical layout, {{option_1}} on the left and {{option_2}} on the right, each shot top-down on the same dark surface, a big VS in the center

slides.headline: Matchup 2: {{option_3}} vs {{option_4}}
slides.visual_prompt: Split vertical layout, {{option_3}} on the left and {{option_4}} on the right, same lighting and surface as matchup 1, a big VS in the center

slides.headline: How to vote
slides.body: One comment, two picks. Example: '1 and 4'. Most comments wins each round.
slides.visual_prompt: Clean instruction card in {{brand}} colors with a sample comment bubble reading two numbers

slides.headline: The final drops {{final_day}}
slides.body: The two winners go head to head. Then it's settled.
slides.visual_prompt: Empty final bracket slot glowing under a spotlight, two blurred silhouettes of the contenders on either side

slides.headline: Defend your pick
slides.body: Tag the friend who's voting wrong.
slides.visual_prompt: Playful card with two comment bubbles arguing, {{brand}} logo small in the corner

cta: Comment your two picks and tag the friend who's voting wrong. The final drops {{final_day}}.

craft.notes: Pair a crowd favorite against a sleeper in each matchup so neither round is a blowout; close races drive more comments. Keep the photos identically lit so the vote is about the thing, not the photo.

do_not: Put two near-identical options in one matchup; nobody has a strong opinion
Ignore the vote result; if the loser wins the bracket, honor it publicly
Run more than four contenders in one carousel; the rules stop fitting on one slide
